Name: WASTE ́S ALCHEMY USA, LLC
Description:
WAUSA is a private company dedicated to research and scientific and technological development. WAUSA provides technological and industrial services to companies and institutions focused on the recovery of  non-hazardous waste, both organic and inorganic.

The innovative spirit of WAUSA focuses on the search for new technological processes that allow the maximum use of available resources. Development and implementation on an industrial scale of our technology will lead to immediate benefits for the environment, generating new lines of ecological business  and creating employment based on the green economy and the efficiency and sustainability of resources.

WAUSA provides integral solutions to its customers in order to enhance their non-hazardous waste and transform it into  solid recovered homogenous fuel (SRF) or new material systems. Solutions created by WAUSA include the method and the machinery necessary to achieve those purposes.

The method developed and patented by WAUSA allows the transformation of non-hazardous waste into homogeneous SRF or new material systems, reducing the pre-treatment of this, as the particle size reduction and the reduction of moisture. The process takes place in a single phase of one hour's duration, within a range of practically zero emissions and does not require the addition of any chemical substance.

Waste ́s Alchemy USA processes non-hazardous waste and produces  homogeneous fuel (SRF). These come from different rejection fractions flows : urban, industrial, agricultural, and forestry. The energy consumption of the process varies between 2 and 5 of the gross energy contained in the homogeneous SRF retrieved and processed waste get a LCV-wet based  2 to 4 times greater than non-processed waste. Our method does not require a certain particle size reduction, or a reduction in the rate of humidity of the waste to be processed.

Name: Light2Learn
Description:
It is now well accepted that education is critical to the global goal of building a sustainable future for all. Furthermore, Education is a basic need that forms a foundation in most, if not all development programs, including the UN Millennium Development Goal to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.

Part of ensuring an equitable and quality education is enabling access to education, and the basic tools necessary to benefit from that education including adequately resourced schools. In many developing areas school buildings exist with none of the basic resources we take for granted in the west, including lighting and water. Lack of adequate lighting in a school is a clear and present barrier that limits the access to education by preventing the use of the building at any times outside of bright sunlight. This limits not only the access to children but also adult education whose free time to learn is after dark.

Formed in 2016, Light2Learn’s mandate is to provide alternative sources of lighting to communal school buildings in rural communities that lack access to a reliable source of electric lighting. The lighting installations will utilise renewable energy sources easily accessible to the local community. It is envisaged that photovoltaic solar energy (PV) will be the primary source used due to its minimum maintenance and wide accessibility.

Name: UNU WEARABLE SOLUTIONS
Description:
UNU is a high-tech pollution monitoring wearable badge to be used by parents who are concerned about the air their babies are breathing daily. It is  made with ethics and sustainability in mind. Its born of the need to take care of baby health and well-being, diagnosing and warning on-site the environmentally contaminated risk areas.

UNU is made of smart textile with flexible sensory panel that is unbreakable, waterproof and easy to handle. It derives real-time data on air quality and transforms it into various colors through fiber optics within the badge structure. However, we don't want it to look like a technology, we want the badge to be integrated in the design of any cloth and bag parents wear. UNU brings love to badges back. We want it to be enchantment internet of things

Whom does it benefit?

To ease the life of multi-functional parents, badge signals the pollution levels as luminescent color changes and the full report can be read on a mobile app. Parents can easily track safer routes to take with their babies. UNU helps to eventually induce a healthier lifestyle for the whole family.

Hay más de 500.000 metros cuadrados de sistemas de calefacción de aire SolarWall en 6 continentes en todo el mundo, desde Alaska hasta el Polo Sur. Estos sistemas están ayudando a las empresas y ayuntamientos a lograr sus objetivos energéticos con el uso de calefacción limpia integrada en el edificio.

En las últimas tres décadas, los ingenieros de Conserval han continuado mejorando la tecnología SolarWall para cumplir con los requisitos de energía de cada proyecto y su diseño. El resultado ha sido un conjunto completo de tecnologías SolarWall que incluyen los sistemas SolarWall 2-Stage, SolarDuct, FV / T y NightSolar.

Desde su comienzo, los sistemas SolarWall han sido probados regularmente por laboratorios de terceros. Y como ningún proyecto de SolarWall es el mismo, nuestros equipos de ventas e ingeniería tienen experiencia para respaldar su proyecto de SolarWall a través de las etapas de estudio de viabilidad, propuesta de negocios, consulta de diseño, proceso de licitación, instalación y puesta en marcha.

Con más de 30 años de experiencia en gestión de proyectos y diseño, e innumerables premios, conocemos perfectamente lo que se necesita para hacer que cada proyecto de SolarWall sea un gran éxito.

Conserval creó The SolarWall Foundation a una organización benéfica canadiense sin ánimo de lucro, para apoyar laincorporación de calefacción solar en colegiosy edificios para que los niños y otras personas puedan disfrutar y aprender sobre los beneficios de la calefacción térmica renovable.

We believe that Energy Efficiency is the single most important future source of energy. As the threats presented by climate change become ever more proven, there are countless excellent global initiatives in place researching and developing alternative energy sources that will, hopefully, lead to the world’s economies becoming less reliant on harmful types of energy generation.

However, one important source of energy is too often overlooked – energy efficiency, we must get more from less. Population levels are projected to increase from 6.5 billion today to 8.3 billion by 2030. At this rate of growth, the world’s demand for energy will have increased by 53%, elevating global CO2 emissions by 55%.

Energy efficiencies in all walks of life will help reduce the effects of climate change, and commerce and industry can make a significant contribution by using the best available technologies to reduce the amount of energy needed to operate facilities.

We are at the forefront of Energy Management, targeting significant reductions in client energy consumption and cost, without inhibiting performance. This is, of course, highly desirable in the current economic climate.

We kept abreast of the latest energy saving incentives.

Macbatec Battery Regeneration Technology

We will help you recover the lost capacity of your batteries!

Since 1998 MacBat Technology (currently branded as MacBatec) offers versatile and fully automated equipment for the regeneration, de-sulphation and maintenance of lead-acid batteries for both traction and standby power supply systems.

Macbatec ensures the Best Battery Economy (cost-benefit) due to:
(i)	The efficiency of our desulphation process;
(ii)	The automation of our technology; and
(iii)	Our continuous technical support.

Our technology works on hard sulphation, cracking the crystals as much as is technically possible. Reaching this level of efficiency is crucial. An incomplete desulphation would raise the battery temperature again, further speeding up crystallisation and dramatically reducing the benefits of the regeneration.

We develop our technology and we provide personal service through our international network.

We look forward to reducing your costs.

Description:
We are a non-profit association that consists of several technical teachers, engineers, technicians and companies involved in Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy issues (> 150 members).
Besides energy efficiency, the areas of work of our association are biomass, solar thermal, solar photovoltaic, wind energy and geothermal energy.
Within the association there are working groups on specific topics of renewable energies in which a large number of partners are involved. These working groups disseminate knowledge through the publication of documents or project implementation.
We believe in energy efficiency as a work option, but also as a real option to favour the competitiveness of the businesses and their profitability.
We are aware of the importance of primary sector in our region and much of our work is focused in agriculture, raising livestock and forestry. In particular:
- Designing, developing and installing energy systems on dairy cattle farms to improve energy resources use and reduce operation costs.
- Providing solutions for the enhancement of forest residues exploitation (biomass) as an energy source, adding value to the management of our natural resources and favouring the control of forest fires.
- Designing 100% renewable energy supply systems for small rural isolated villages, based on biomass and solar energy sources.
Also, we provide solutions to businesses and households to improve the energy efficiency of new buildings and the renovation of the old ones without losing comfort or quality of life.
As for the skills of the staff involved we have teachers who have prepared teaching materials related to renewable energy sources (books and technical manuals), have participated in technical conferences and have won national and regional awards for educational innovation in the field of renewable energies and professionals who have worked in biomass and photovoltaic solar installations. Also, some of them have participated in European projects.

Description:
No dude en enviarnos una solicitud de presupuesto para poder hacerle una propuesta y estudio técnico de su instalación fotovoltaica sin ningún tipo de compromiso por su parte. Comprobará que invertir en energías renovables es sin duda una inversión segura, rentable y sostenible.


El autoconsumo eléctrico permite producir y consumir su propia electricidad instalando sistemas de generación renovable como pueden ser los paneles solares fotovoltaicos u otros dispositivos como aerogeneradores.

Impulsar las renovables, implica un ahorro en la factura eléctrica y una menor dependencia de los cambios de precio de la tarifa eléctrica, ya que una parte del consumo se cubre con la energía generada por el sistema de autoconsumo.

La nueva normativa de autoconsumo facilita trámites, reconoce el derecho a autoconsumir energía eléctrica renovable sin peajes ni cargos y permite que estos sistemas se instalen a nivel individual o de forma compartida.

El punto de partida es disponer del espacio necesario: tejado, cubiertas, jardín, etcétera, pero también son muy importantes las características de la zona donde se resida y su orientación respecto al sol o el recurso de viento, ya que es vital para sacar el máximo rendimiento de la instalación. En el caso de los paneles solares fotovoltaicos, estos son más productivos cuando los rayos del sol inciden de forma perpendicular, por lo que la orientación sur es la mejor, aunque otras orientaciones también son viables. Además, la nueva normativa permite que la instalación de autoconsumo no tenga que estar conectada necesariamente al edificio donde queremos autoconsumir, sino que puede ser una instalación “próxima”.

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos dos ingenieros industriales que comparten inquietudes y aficiones hacia la naturaleza, su conservación y las nuevas tecnologías. Ello nos ayuda a desenvolver esta idea con la que intentaremos conseguir un mejor futuro a través del beneficio común. Acercaremos la energía renovable al mayor número posible de hogares. 

¿Cómo lo haremos?

Diseñando una solución estándar con paneles fotovoltaicos, para permitir al usuario la inmersión en el autoconsumo energético. Como hemos podido comprobar en las validaciones del producto, los consumidores demandan una inversión reducida, que podrá ser ampliable a nuevas opciones de autoconsumo.

Una reducción de las emisiones de carbono, dar solución a uno de los retos más importantes en la transición energética, la generación distribuida. Y también, se fomentará el trabajo de proximidad, prevaleciendo en todo momento los productos manufacturados en la península.

Name: Apolo Iberia
Description:
El mundo está en constante cambio, y la velocidad de estos cambios es cada vez mayor. El crecimiento demográfico y el continuo desarrollo económico están produciendo un fuerte incremento en el consumo energético mundial, por lo que la energía es a día de hoy una necesidad fundamental para cualquier persona, empresa o nación en el planeta. 

Tradicionalmente las fuentes de generación fósil han sido la base para cubrir esta necesidad, pero sus consecuencias en el cambio climático son ya una realidad que están produciendo numerosas catástrofes medio ambientales. La solución a este nuevo reto pasa por el cambio en las fuentes de generación de energía. Las energías renovables, infinitas y limpias, son la solución para abastecer y ayudar a la Humanidad en su proceso de desarrollo y bienestar, y con su uso, Personas y Planeta, se unen en coexistencia, de forma que preservamos y cuidamos el Hábitat en el que vivimos. 

Apolo Iberia entiende que todas las personas e instituciones deben de tener una actitud proactiva y responsable en su ámbito de vida frente a estos retos y amenazas, por lo que promueve y fomenta el uso de las energías renovables para conseguir el desarrollo sostenible de la Humanidad, respetando en sus procesos el medio ambiente y buscando además la excelencia en los productos y servicios que ofrece a sus clientes para lograr su máxima satisfacción.

Name: United Energies MTOI
Description:
United Energies MTOI is a Spanish manufacturer of wind power systems and specialist for gearless wind turbines in the 1.67 to 2.5 MW power class. The UE DirectDrive turbine family offers with its simplicity and modularity a long lifespan, high reliability and reduced maintenance costs while the highly developed control electronics maximises the energy output. This results in an increase of availability and, at the end, of profitability of the wind energy project.

Founded in 1998 as part of the Research, Development and Implementation (RDI) program at M.TORRES Group, United Energies started producing wind turbines in 2001. In 2015, the Swiss investment company SwissEnergy AG acquired the wind turbine technologist and manufacturer to turn it into a high-tech wind industry developer providing emerging markets with solutions, to handle the increased interest in renewable energy sources and to export an industry for the production of wind turbines to the places of electricity
demand.

During the technology transfer process, United Energies MTOI is offering different scopes of works with the final aim of local wind turbine manufacturing, local supply chain development and installation, maintenance and operation of the wind farms. The selected scope will depend on specific project needs, and it can be done in stages in order to minimise risks and initial investments. 

The full scope includes a license for: manufacturing, selling, quality assuring, installation, commissioning, and operation & maintenance of a high-tech direct drive wind turbine (UE 1.67 DirectDrive). 

United Energies MTOI aims to a close cooperation between parties as an important social and ethic business objective, offering a “shared experiences network” providing room for learning, participation and improvements.

Name: MOTORDISC ELECTRIC TRANSMISSION
Description:
Motordisc is a twofold Project:
1. A project of electric hybridization of vehicles with traditional explosion engine based on a KIT that includes "flat" type electric motors placed on the brake calipers that allows (i) the electric traction of the vehicle and (ii) the use of braking for the generation of electricity (due to the utilization of inverter type electric motors).

2. A new urban car-sharing concept with vehicles of small size and weight, as an alternative to current car sharing and bike sharing companies.

The regenerative braking system/electric traction provides a clearly innovative component that consists of placing said electric motors in the brake calipers of each wheel. Thanks to this innovation, this system is much less complex from the technical and installation point of view, than other similar projects that are being carried out, since it can be adapted to each car model easily and at a limited cost.

The system is called Motordisc Electric Transmission and has been granted the Spanish patent ES2597203 and is in the final phase of approval of the patent for Europe, United States and China (reference international patent WO 2017/009512 A1).

It is a project with clear ecological and social components, allowing to open the world of electric hybridization to segments of the population with less access to new hybrid/electric vehicles.
